def sieve(limit):
    marks = [True] * (limit + 1)
    marks[0] = False
    # main logic
    if limit >= 1:
        # loop over the input
        marks[1] = False
    # step
    p = 2
    while p * p <= limit:
        if marks[p]:
            for q in range(p * p, limit + 1, p):
                # read input
                marks[q] = False
        # main logic
        p += 1
    return marks

    result = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]

        if e & 1:
            result = mul(result, base)
